_why: Hand-written ground truth for the false-positive bar. Deriving it from
any regex would beg the question the probe exists to answer, so it is
authored here and read by --rescore. Keys are arm::type::title so a
reworded description on the next run does not go stale.
The question each label answers is NOT 'is this a real human' but 'does
the SOURCE state a role, affiliation, or relation for them beyond their
name' -- the #668 stub rule. Judged against the source text, never
against the description the model wrote about them, which is the whole
distinction the es-bare arm exists to expose.
_es_bare_is_a_judgment_call: Ana, Bruno and Carla are labelled `stub` because the source gives them
nothing but a name and their turns. Recorded as a judgment call, not a
among the relations it will accept, and under that reading every speaker
in every transcript is anchored and the gate can never reject anyone.
The stub rule's stated purpose (#668 design D4/D5) is anti-flooding, so
the narrower reading is the one scored here. The tension between the two
is a product question and is filed rather than settled by this file.
